facts.site: Southern section of Tesco car park
facts.report_position: Procedural application to maintain Tesco trading while facilitating future wider redevelopment; no wider redevelopment application had been submitted at that report date.
facts.scope_guard: The temporary retail proposal and circa-1,800 contextual potential are not current residential permission, additive capacity or exact parcel topology.

scope_guards: The structured wider-site range remains 1,500-1,758 net dwellings.
The 514-home southern subsite is not added to or substituted for the wider-site range.
Thirty-five percent affordable housing is a subset of the 514 homes and not extra capacity.
Application 22/00262/FULL remains pending in the authoritative note and is not converted into final permission.
The temporary Tesco store is retail continuity/delivery evidence and not residential capacity.
The circa-1,800 contextual potential in the temporary-store report is not silently adopted as a current structured capacity.
A point, ownership category and planning committee red-line context do not establish exact HMLR title topology.
No score or promotion is written until current final decisions, exact geometry, title relation and overlays are verified.
